    - heading "Amazon Aurora" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Unparalleled high performance and availability at global scale for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and DSQL
    - button "Get started with Aurora"
    - button "Connect with an Aurora specialist"
    - heading "What is Aurora" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Aurora is a serverless, relational database service that is easy to use with zero infrastructure management, zero downtime maintenance, and instant scaling to any demand. Aurora offers 6x the throughput of PostgreSQL and MySQL, and is fully compatible with PostgreSQL and MySQL. With Aurora DSQL, you have the fastest serverless distributed SQL database that is PostgreSQL-compatible. Aurora is designed for up to 99.999% multi-Region availability and virtually unlimited scale in and across regions to meet your workload needs. Broad compliance standards and enterprise security capabilities along with effortless integration with analytics and agentic AI services makes Aurora ideal for your relational workloads.
